title: Can MCP Clients Decide What to Do After Failure? A Result-Only Actionability Audit
abstract: arXiv:2609.00072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A client that receives isError:true knows that something went wrong. It may still have no machine-readable basis for deciding whether to fix an argument, authenticate, wait, choose another tool, or stop. This paper studies what deterministic software can learn from a completed MCP failure result alone; request arguments, schemas, discovery history, authen- tication state, transport metadata, host policy, and ap- plication state are outside that boundary. We introduce a six-part actionability profile and apply it with record- level evidence. In a small illustrative study of 21 safely induced failures from ten reachable sampled servers, typed fields expose failure in 18 cases and a broad policy in 8, yet expose no specific cause, target, executable repair, or replay constraint. translated_title: MCP客户端能否在失败后决定下一步做什么？一种仅基于结果的可操作性审计
translated_abstract: 接收到isError:true的客户端知道出了问题，但仍可能没有机器可读的依据来决定是修复参数、进行身份验证、等待、选择另一个工具还是停止。本文研究了确定性软件仅从已完成的MCP失败结果中能获取什么信息；请求参数、模式、发现历史、身份验证状态、传输元数据、主机策略和应用状态都在该边界之外。我们引入了一个由六部分组成的可操作性分析框架，并以记录级证据加以应用。在一项对来自十个可达采样服务器的21个安全诱导失败的小型示例研究中，类型化字段在18个案例中暴露了失败信息，在8个案例中暴露了宽泛的策略信息，但均未暴露具体原因、目标、可执行的修复方法或重放约束。自然语言描述通常携带更多的原因和目标信息，但代价是将语义解释纳入了恢复路径之中。一项词汇层面的来源审计发现……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种仅基于MCP失败结果的可操作性审计框架，发现类型化字段虽能暴露失败和宽泛策略信息，但缺乏具体原因、目标和可执行修复方法，而自然语言描述虽含更丰富的信息却需要语义解释才能用于恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a result-only actionability audit for MCP failure results, finding that typed fields expose failure and broad policy but lack specific cause, target, and executable repair information, while prose carries richer recovery information at the cost of requiring semantic interpretation.
